title: QUIZ - 27
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Recall the numeric factor represented by a metric prefix
questions.question: The prefix 'hecto-' attached to the base unit 'gram' means multiplying the gram by what factor?
questions.explanation: The metric prefix 'hecto-' always represents a factor of 100 times the base unit, regardless of which base unit (gram) it is attached to.
questions.hint: Metric prefixes represent fixed powers of ten, independent of the base unit.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the Celsius-to-Fahrenheit conversion formula
questions.question: Convert \(16^\circ\text{C}\) to Fahrenheit using \( F = \frac{9}{5}C + 32 \).
questions.explanation: Substituting \(C=16\) into \(F=\frac{9}{5}C+32\) gives \(F=\frac{9}{5}(16)+32=28.8+32=60.8^\circ\text{F}\).
questions.hint: Multiply the Celsius value by 9/5 first, then add 32.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the Celsius-to-Fahrenheit conversion formula
questions.question: Convert \(10^\circ\text{C}\) to Fahrenheit using \( F = \frac{9}{5}C + 32 \).
questions.explanation: Substituting \(C=10\) into \(F=\frac{9}{5}C+32\) gives \(F=\frac{9}{5}(10)+32=18.0+32=50^\circ\text{F}\).
questions.hint: Multiply the Celsius value by 9/5 first, then add 32.

questions.concept: Converting Between Customary and Metric Units
questions.learningObjective: Apply an approximate conversion factor between customary and metric units
questions.question: Using the approximation 1 pound \(\approx 0.45\) kilograms, convert 5 pounds to kilograms (rounded to one decimal place).
questions.explanation: Multiply by the conversion factor: \(5\text{ lb}\times0.45\text{ kg/lb}=2.25\text{ kg}\), which rounds to \(2.3\text{ kg}\) to one decimal place.
questions.hint: Multiply by the approximate conversion factor to move from the given unit to the target unit.

questions.question: Convert \(23^\circ\text{C}\) to Fahrenheit using \( F = \frac{9}{5}C + 32 \).
questions.explanation: Substituting \(C=23\) into \(F=\frac{9}{5}C+32\) gives \(F=\frac{9}{5}(23)+32=41.4+32=73.4^\circ\text{F}\).
questions.hint: Multiply the Celsius value by 9/5 first, then add 32.
